Over 70 educational freedom programs now operate across more than 30 states — a remarkable expansion of school choice in America. 

Cato's @ColleenHroncich identifies the five key components every successful program needs and shows how states like Florida and Arizona are leading the way.

ow.ly/fSuA50YXRfv

President Trump is right to withdraw troops from Germany and from Europe, explain Cato’s @JustinTLogan and American Ideas Institute’s Sumantra Maitra:

“German and broader European security do not require American power in theater by the division.”

ow.ly/KjGO50YZyQX

Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974 sat dormant for 50 years for good reason. In a new Cato Podcast episode, @clark_packard and @AlfredCObregon break down why courts keep rejecting the administration’s tariff theories and what the looming Section 301 investigations mean for American importers.

Listen on Apple, Spotify, and our website!

Apple: ow.ly/7KnG50YZAA1 
Spotify: ow.ly/4HRf50YZAA0 
Website: ow.ly/sfHy50YZAzV

Join us for a conversation with President and CEO of DonorsTrust @Lawson_Bader, Cato Senior Fellow @walterolson, and President of the John D. and Catherine T. MacArthur Foundation @jpalfrey on the importance of philanthropic freedom and what’s at stake when the state asserts authority over private giving.
nitter.net/i/broadcasts/1yxBeMozB…

We were honored to host Secretary of Energy @SecretaryWright at the Cato Institute for a wide-ranging conversation on the current state of energy policy — and the market revolutions to come. 

Watch the full discussion on YouTube and our website.

YouTube: ow.ly/uk8S50YZMJn 
Website: ow.ly/w43m50YZMJ6

Drug prohibition was never the solution — it was the problem. Cato's @dr4liberty explains why protecting people means trusting them to make their own choices.

Video

High gas prices stem from the Iran War, not the gas tax. But the gas tax should still be repealed to let states fund the 98% of roads they already own, says Cato's @adamnmichel.

ow.ly/qZP450YZ4Lz

“The great success of Fairfax, Virginia, highlights the value of immigration to the country.” — Cato's Director of Immigration Studies @David_J_Bier, testifying before the House Judiciary Subcommittee on Immigration Integrity, Security, and Enforcement. 

Watch the testimony here: ow.ly/3Lr850YZzU7

Key homebuilding inputs are made more expensive both by existing and newly imposed import tariffs. 

To improve housing affordability, tariffs on home construction materials and appliances should be eliminated, says Cato’s @sslivinski. 

Learn more in the Cato “Handbook on Affordability”: ow.ly/tN8y50YYoei

At Cato, our scholars have developed 100+ policy ideas to defuse inflation and lower the cost of living. 

Check out our “Handbook on Affordability”: cato.org/handbook-affordabil…

President Trump’s approval on handling the economy and inflation is now worse than President Biden’s ever was.  

“With no relief in sight from either tariffs or energy prices, Trump’s already-historic inflation disapproval may have further yet to fall,” say Cato’s @MrRBourne, @JaiKedia, and Nathan Miller. 

ow.ly/HMCN50YZxYF

Kevin Warsh was confirmed as Fed Chair on May 13th. He's right on a number of things, but the real test will be whether he can move monetary policy from discretion to a clear, rules-based framework, says Cato’s @JaiKedia.

The “Summer of Our Discontent” by Thomas Chatterton Williams confronts the breakdown of civility in America. Join Williams for a discussion with Cato’s Erec Smith about the existential crisis facing American liberalism, and how we might move beyond the current impasse toward a more integrated and resilient public square.

Register to attend in person or watch live: ow.ly/Y37b50YYXxc

Educational freedom should be something parents can count on — year after year. Cato's @ColleenHroncich lays out what every program needs to get right:  
cato.org/policy-analysis/let…

Video

How can America unleash the next energy revolution? The Cato Institute is hosting Secretary of Energy @SecretaryWright to discuss the current state of energy policy — and what's to come. nitter.net/i/broadcasts/1RKZzjNrv…

President Trump's fertility treatment proposal would cut some regulations and save some workers money—but it's not much of a win for liberty or consumer sovereignty, says Cato's @mfcannon. 

For every $1 of tax savings, workers must surrender control of $3 of their earnings to their employer.

ow.ly/OjLX50YZ11O

Can dollarization play a key role in achieving stability and growth in Latin America? 

Join Cato for a discussion featuring @VasquezIan, @JohnHCochrane, @DavidRMalpass, and @ocampo_emilio — exploring the mechanics of dollarization and why this reform is especially relevant to Argentina and Venezuela today.

Register to attend in person or watch live: ow.ly/Ourg50YZ0Sv
